# Tools

Every tool is published as `coordination_<name>`. The role is read from the session's agent id; a tool called by another role is refused and the refusal is recorded as an event.

## Every role

| Tool | Roles | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `whoami` | any | Show who you are in this project: name, role, your current work item, questions waiting for your answer, active holds. |
| `peers` | any | List the sessions you can address: agents of this project with role, status and current item, and Claude Code sessions. |
| `board` | any | The work board by front: what is moving now, what comes next, what waits, and the latest measures. |
| `item` | any | One work item with its fields and its timeline of events. |
| `ask` | any | Ask a question of a peer, a role (coordinator, pm, engineer) or a Claude Code session. |
| `answer` | any | Answer a question that was sent to you, by its record id (8 characters work). |
| `note` | any | Attach a short free-text note to a work item. |
| `record` | any | Return one stored message exactly as kept, by its record id (the full id or its first 8 characters). |
| `history` | any | Read the ledger. |
| `sent` | any | List the messages this session sent, newest first, each with its record id. |
| `received` | any | List the messages addressed to this session, newest first, with record ids. |
| `owner_order` | any | Record an order the owner gave you directly, with the owner's exact words. |
| `safety` | any | Raise a safety matter (memory exhaustion, data loss, history rewrite). |
| `incident` | any | Report a communication or process failure: a lost or invented message, an instruction with no record id, a wrong channel, a defect found outside your scope. |

## Engineer

| Tool | Roles | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `available` | engineer | Tell the coordinator you can take work: at the start of a session, after your pull request merged or closed, or when your work is blocked and you can take something else. |
| `claim` | engineer | Claim an assigned item: its branch, worktree and the files you will change. |
| `scope` | engineer | Send the coordinator a scope note before design-heavy work: files, numbers, refusals, and numbered open questions. |
| `progress` | engineer | Post one line of progress on your item (what is done, what is left, when you expect to be ready). |
| `ready` | engineer | Mark your item ready for review after you marked the pull request ready. |
| `blocked` | engineer | Say that your item is blocked, on what, and which event unblocks it. |
| `defect_found` | engineer | Record a defect you found outside your assignment so it is not lost. |
| `handover` | engineer | Hand your item back to the coordinator, with what is left and the data others rely on. |

## Coordinator

| Tool | Roles | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `accept` | coordinator | Accept a proposed work item, with conditions. |
| `defer` | coordinator | Defer a proposed item, with the reason and what will bring it back. |
| `reject` | coordinator | Reject a proposed item, with the reason. |
| `cancel` | coordinator | Cancel an item that is no longer wanted, with the reason. |
| `refine` | coordinator | Complete an accepted item so it can be assigned: the files it will touch, the observable done-when, an estimate in blocks, constraints and reserved identifiers. |
| `breakdown` | coordinator | Break an initiative into activities of one pull request each. |
| `assign` | coordinator | Assign a ready item to an engineer. |
| `reassign` | coordinator | Pass an item that is stalled or orphaned to another engineer. |
| `verdict` | coordinator | Record a review verdict on an item in review. |
| `merged` | coordinator | Record that an item's pull request merged, with the merge commit. |
| `hold` | coordinator | Declare a hold on paths or pull requests, or a freeze of everything. |
| `lift` | coordinator | End a hold or freeze by its id. |
| `queue` | coordinator | Your review queue and loose ends: items in review in the order they became ready, pull requests that do not contain main, quiet items, blocked items, and free engineers with the next ready items. |
| `state` | coordinator | The STATE digest: merged, in flight, blocked, stalled, free engineers, owner decisions pending. |
| `decision_answer` | coordinator | Answer a product manager's decision: done (with what you assigned), cannot (with the reason), accepted (will be done, with when) or in_progress. |

## Product manager

| Tool | Roles | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `propose` | product-manager | Propose a work item to the coordinator. |
| `decide` | product-manager | Record a product decision (a priority, or the removal of a roadblock) and send it to the coordinator, who carries it out and answers done or cannot within a block. |
| `prioritize` | product-manager | Set the order of work in a front. |
| `measure` | product-manager | Record a measurement of a product measure, with the committed record that holds it. |
| `validate` | product-manager | Mark an item validated: checked against something independent of the work, under a rule fixed beforehand (a real capture, a held-out judgement, the owner's acceptance). |
| `park` | product-manager | Park a front that waits for something outside the team, with the reason and the event that unparks it. |
| `unpark` | product-manager | End the parking of a front, so its stalls are raised again from now on. |
| `stall` | product-manager | Tell the coordinator that a goal or item has stalled: nothing merged, assigned or committed. |
| `summary` | product-manager | Write one line of the executive status: where a front stands, a risk, or a decision the sponsor must take. |
| `bundle` | product-manager | Assemble the owner bundle from the ledger: the measures that moved, then the decisions that wait for the owner (escalations, safety matters), then the open stalls. |

## Shared between roles

| Tool | Roles | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `result` | engineer, product-manager | Report what a merged item measured against its prediction: before, after, the committed record, and whether it met, missed or was inconclusive. |
